# KCC Direct Controller Logic Greenfield Implementer (Autogenerated Controller & Fuzzer)

Follow this workflow to autogenerate (or verify the already-autogenerated) direct controller and round-trip fuzzer for `{kind}`, create minimal and maximal E2E test fixtures, and record golden logs against real GCP.

---

## Step 0: Verify Post-Judgement Prerequisite (`apis/<service>/judgement_queue.yaml`)

Before generating or finalizing the controller and E2E fixtures for `{kind}`, verify that `{kind}`'s `untriaged-bulk-generation` and all actionable entries in `apis/<service>/judgement_queue.yaml` are `status: resolved` (and top-level `Labels` is not left in `<Kind>Spec`). If `{kind}` still has open actionable entries in `judgement_queue.yaml`, complete Step 1b (`.gemini/skills/kcc-direct-greenfield-types-implementer/judgement/SKILL.md`) first.

---

## Step 1: Autogenerate Controller and Fuzzer (One-Shot `controllerbuilder` Commands)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Never add `generate-controller` or `generate-fuzzer` to `apis/<service>/generate.sh`.** `generate.sh` runs on every CI build (`make generate` → `dev/tasks/generate-types-and-mappers` → `validate-generated-files`), and `generate-controller --prepopulate-resource` overwrites any file marked `// +generated:controller` on every run, silently discarding customizations. Run the generators **once**, directly, and commit the output. If `generate.sh` still invokes them for `{kind}`, remove `{kind}`'s `--resource` flag in this PR (and the whole invocation if no `--resource` flags remain).

1. **Check Whether the Controller and Fuzzer Already Exist**:
   If `pkg/controller/direct/<service>/<proto_lower>_controller.go` (with `// +generated:controller`) and `pkg/controller/direct/<service>/<kind_lower>_fuzzer.generated.go` already exist (from bulk generation or Step 1b) and compile against the finalized types, skip to step 2. Otherwise, first run `generate.sh` so types, identities, and mappers are current **and** the proto descriptor (`.build/googleapis.pb`) exists, then generate the controller and fuzzer once:
   ```bash
   SKIP_GENERATE_CRDS=1 ./apis/<service>/generate.sh

   # One-shot generation. Do NOT add these commands to apis/<service>/generate.sh.
   REPO_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"  # needed for --proto-source-path below
   cd "${REPO_ROOT}/dev/tools/controllerbuilder"
   go run . generate-controller \
     --service <proto.service.package> \
     --api-version <service>.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1alpha1 \
     --prepopulate-resource \
     --resource <Kind>:<ProtoResource>
   go run . generate-fuzzer \
     --service <proto.service.package> \
     --api-version <service>.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1alpha1 \
     --prepopulate-resource \
     --resource <Kind>:<ProtoResource>
   cd -
   ```
   *(If `apis/<service>/generate.sh` pins `--proto-source-path ${REPO_ROOT}/.build/googleapis-<sha>.pb` on `generate-types`, pass the same `--proto-source-path` flag to both commands.)*

   > [!CAUTION]
   > If `generate-controller` logs `could not load proto ... scaffolding will guess the resource name shape`, **stop**: it still writes a controller, but without proto-driven RPC/LRO/ID handling. Ensure the descriptor exists (re-run `generate.sh` or `./dev/tools/controllerbuilder/generate-proto.sh`, and pass `--proto-source-path` if the service pins one), then re-run the one-shot commands.

   > [!WARNING]
   > Re-running `generate-controller --prepopulate-resource` overwrites `<proto_lower>_controller.go` (no `--overwrite` needed while it carries `// +generated:controller`). Do not re-run it after you have customized the controller, or your changes will be lost. Record golden logs only against the final, committed controller code.

2. **Update `static_config.go` (MANDATORY)**:
   ```bash
   python3 dev/tasks/generate_static_config.py
   ```
   Generation produces:
   - `pkg/controller/direct/<service>/<proto_lower>_controller.go` (marked with `// +generated:controller`)
   - `pkg/controller/direct/<service>/<kind_lower>_fuzzer.generated.go` (marked with `// +generated:fuzzer`)
   - Service registration in `pkg/controller/direct/register/register.go` and `pkg/controller/resourceconfig/static_config.go`

3. **Handle Complex / High-Touch Resource Cases**:
   - **Missing GAPIC Modules or Multi-Service Packages (`iam/apiv3`, `dialogflow` spanning `v2` + `cx/v3`, `mapmanagement/apiv2`):** If `go build` fails on a missing GAPIC package, run `go get cloud.google.com/go/<service>@latest && go mod tidy && (cd mockgcp && go mod tidy)` so both `go.mod` and `mockgcp/go.mod` stay aligned (`validate-ensure`).
   - **Shared/Legacy Package Mapper Collisions (`<kind_lower>_mapper.go`):** If `pkg/controller/direct/<service>/mapper.generated.go` cannot be regenerated via `generate-mapper` without clobbering existing mockgcp or multi-service mappers (or if `v1alpha1`/`v1beta1` types collide), isolate `{kind}`'s mapper functions in `pkg/controller/direct/<service>/<kind_lower>_mapper.go` (matching `TestDirectResourceFileNaming`) or pass `--multiversion` to `generate-mapper`.
   - **Custom LROs & Immutable Resources Without `Update*` RPCs:** For immutable resources without an `Update*` RPC, verify `Update` refreshes status (`a.setStatus(u, actual)`) without calling an `Update*` RPC, and resolve any `// TODO:` markers in `<proto_lower>_controller.go`.
   - **`TestRegisteredTemplatesMatchCAI` & `TestVerifyLabelsTestCasesExist`:** Run `go test ./pkg/gcpurls/... ./pkg/test/resourcefixture/... -run "TestRegisteredTemplatesMatchCAI|TestVerifyLabelsTestCasesExist"`. If `{kind}`'s URL template is absent from CAI's asset inventory table, add it to `ignoredTemplates` in `pkg/gcpurls/registry_test.go`.

4. **Verify Compilation & 200-Seed Fuzzer Round-Trip Immediately**:
   - Check that `pkg/controller/direct/<service>/...` compiles and passes 200-seed focused round-trip fuzzing:
     ```bash
     go test ./pkg/controller/direct/<service>/...
     FOCUS=<Kind> go test -v ./pkg/fuzztesting/fuzztests -run TestFocusedMappers
     go test -v ./tests/apichecks -run "TestGenerateScripts|TestDirectResourceFileNaming"
     ```
   - If `TestFocusedMappers` fails, inspect any inline `// HINT:` comments in `<kind_lower>_fuzzer.generated.go` and the `<hint_for_agent>...</hint_for_agent>` block in the test output to fix the underlying mapper or configure `FilterSpec` / `FilterStatus`.
   - Verify `<proto_lower>_controller.go` satisfies the 5 Canonical Greenfield Controller Standards:
     1. **GAPIC REST Client (`New<Service>RESTClient`)** with `m.config.RESTClientOptions()` (falling back to `New<Service>Client` with `m.config.GRPCClientOptions()` only if REST is unsupported by the service).
     2. **`common.NormalizeGreenfieldReferences(ctx, reader, obj)`** called first in `AdapterForObject`.
     3. **`IdentityV2` (`obj.GetIdentity`) or `ServerGeneratedIdentity`** handled cleanly in `AdapterForObject`, `Create`, and `setStatus`.
     4. **`common.CompareGreenfieldSpec(ctx, a.desired, actual, krm.<Kind>Spec_FromProto)`** (or `common.CompareGreenfieldSpecAndLabels(..., a.labels)` when reconciling top-level proto `labels` via `metadata.labels`) used in `Update` together with `structuredreporting.ReportDiff(ctx, report)`.
     5. **Post-LRO `Get<Resource>`** after `Create`/`Update` LROs when needed, and `setStatus(u, resolved)` called on every `Create` and `Update` path (including no-op updates).


---

## Step 2: Create Minimal and Maximal E2E Fixtures

1. **Minimal Fixture** (`pkg/test/resourcefixture/testdata/basic/<service>/<version>/<kind_lower>/<kind_lower>-minimal/`):
   - `create.yaml`: Include only the bare minimum **required** Spec fields (use `${uniqueId}` for resource names and `${projectId}` where needed).
   - `update.yaml`: Modify mutable fields from `create.yaml` (omit `update.yaml` only if the resource has no mutable fields or no Update RPC).
   - `dependencies.yaml`: Include any prerequisite KCC resources referenced by `create.yaml`.

2. **Maximal Fixture** (`pkg/test/resourcefixture/testdata/basic/<service>/<version>/<kind_lower>/<kind_lower>-maximal/`):
   - `create.yaml`: Populate **every supported Spec field** (create additional sibling fixture directories if certain Spec fields are mutually exclusive `oneof`s).
   - `update.yaml`: Modify all mutable fields defined in `create.yaml`.
   - `dependencies.yaml`: Include all prerequisite KCC resources.

3. **Parent fields** (as `<Kind>Spec` models them; see `kcc-direct-greenfield-types-implementer/judgement/references/PARENT_AND_IDENTITY.md`). Never change them in `update.yaml`.
   ```yaml
   # Top-level resource (project + location parent)
   spec:
     projectRef:
       external: projects/${projectId}
     location: us-central1
   ---
   # Child resource: spec.parentRef names the parent, which dependencies.yaml creates
   spec:
     parentRef:
       name: <parentkind>-${uniqueId}
   ```
   If the parent's reference type is external-only (`External` only), create the parent in `dependencies.yaml` with the KCC kind that manages it and set `parentRef: {external: <the parent's full resource name>}`.

---

## Step 3: Remove from Ratcheting Exclusions (MANDATORY)

Open `tests/e2e/ratcheting.go`, locate `ShouldTestRereconiliation`, and remove any `case` entry for `<Kind>` so re-reconciliation testing is enabled.

---

## Step 4: Record Golden Logs Against Real GCP (`hack/record-gcp`)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **STRICT GUARDRAIL — DO NOT USE MOCKGCP**: You MUST record golden files against real GCP using `RECORD_AUDIT_PROBE=1 ./hack/record-gcp`. Never use `E2E_GCP_TARGET=mock` or `hack/compare-mock` in Step 2.

Run from the repository root:
```bash
RECORD_AUDIT_PROBE=1 ./hack/record-gcp "fixtures/^<kind_lower>-minimal$"
RECORD_AUDIT_PROBE=1 ./hack/record-gcp "fixtures/^<kind_lower>-maximal$"
```
- `hack/record-gcp` (`E2E_GCP_TARGET=real WRITE_GOLDEN_OUTPUT=1`) automatically validates `_http.log` (`V1`–`V7`, including protobuf schema and LRO `@type` validation) and writes `_http_report.md` in each fixture directory. Always stage `_http_report.md` alongside `_http.log`, and never hand-edit `_http.log` or `_http_report.md`.
- Once a fixture provisions on real GCP, reaches `Ready`, deletes cleanly, and writes `_http.log`, `_http_report.md`, and `_audit_probe.log`, **do not re-run `hack/record-gcp` for minor log variations**—normalize volatile fields in `tests/e2e/normalize.go` instead.
- If real GCP reports a disabled API, enable it via `gcloud services enable <service>.googleapis.com` and retry.

---

## Step 5: Validation & PR Readiness

1. Run validation checks (without re-running `hack/record-gcp`; do NOT create individual CI presubmit scripts):
   ```bash
   dev/ci/presubmits/fuzz-roundtrippers
   WRITE_GOLDEN_OUTPUT=1 go test -v ./tests/apichecks/... -run TestCRDFieldPresenceInTestsForAlpha
   go test ./tests/apichecks/... ./pkg/controller/direct/<service>/...
   go test ./pkg/gcpurls/... ./pkg/test/resourcefixture/... -run "TestRegisteredTemplatesMatchCAI|TestVerifyLabelsTestCasesExist"
   ```
   Don't run the fixtures against MockGCP in this step (`dev/ci/presubmits/tests-e2e-fixtures-suite <service>` runs them against mocks): MockGCP comes in Step 3.
2. Run `make ready-pr` and commit all changes.
3. In the PR description, document the GCP project used for `record-gcp` and post the `gcloud logging read 'logName:"audit" AND "<service>"' --freshness=3h --limit=50` output as a PR comment.
